items.question: Can I request a custom design?
items.answer: Yes. Send a photo, sketch, STL file, product link or just describe the idea on WhatsApp. We'll confirm size, material, colour and price before printing anything.

items.question: What can I send as a reference for custom printing?
items.answer: Any of these works: a photo, a hand sketch, an STL/OBJ model, a product link or a rough description with dimensions. More detail means a faster, more accurate quote.

items.question: Do you print prototypes and functional parts?
items.answer: Yes. We print prototypes, brackets, holders, replacement parts and other functional pieces. Tell us what the part does so we can suggest the right material and strength.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Open any product, choose quantity and colour, and tap Enquire on WhatsApp. Your selection is filled into the message. We confirm price and delivery, then start printing after you approve.

items.question: Can I choose the colour?
items.answer: For most products, yes. Available colours vary by design and material, so ask on WhatsApp before ordering and we'll confirm what's in stock.

items.question: What materials do you print with?
items.answer: Mostly PLA and PETG, which suit décor, gifts and everyday functional use. If you need a specific material or finish, mention it in your enquiry.

items.question: How long does an order take?
items.answer: Ready designs usually take a few days. Custom or large pieces take longer. We give you a clear timeline when we confirm the order.

items.question: Do you deliver outside Delhi & NCR?
items.answer: We focus on Delhi & NCR. For other cities, message us with your pincode and we'll tell you if delivery is possible and what it costs.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Delivery charges depend on your location, the size of the piece and the number of items. We share the exact amount before you confirm the order.

items.question: Can I order in bulk or for gifting?
items.answer: Yes. We take corporate gifting, return gifts and event orders. Share the quantity and date, and we'll quote a per-piece price.

items.question: Can you change the size of an existing product?
items.answer: Often, yes. Many designs can be scaled up or down. Ask for the size you need and we'll confirm if it prints well at that size.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: We confirm payment details on WhatsApp once the order is agreed. UPI and bank transfer are the usual options.

items.question: What if my piece arrives damaged?
items.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with photos within 48 hours of delivery. We'll look at it and arrange a repair, reprint or refund as per our returns policy.

items.question: Can I return a custom-made piece?
items.answer: Custom pieces are made only for you, so they can't be returned unless they arrive damaged or different from what we agreed. Check the returns page for details.

items.question: How do I care for 3D printed décor?
items.answer: Keep it away from direct heat and long sun exposure. Wipe with a dry or slightly damp soft cloth. Avoid harsh cleaners.

items.question: Can I leave a review?
items.answer: Yes. Open the product you bought and use the review form at the bottom. Reviews are checked by our team before they appear on the site.
